Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!

--- pemu core-macro: IHP SRAM macro integration (see flow/map/macro_integration_notes.md) ---
Custom PDN_CFG = LibreLane's default minus the macro grid (PDN-0233 on the single-layer tile). Power reaches the macro through Pemu.MacroColumnStripes (librelane_plugin_pemu_pdn.py).

check_power_grid runs inside GeneratePDN, before the stripe step connects the macro, so its count is not a verdict. Verdicts: Pemu.MacroColumnStripes property check (fails the step), LVS, IR drop report.

x = 3.36 puts the left-array VDD/VSS columns under the VPWR/VGND pairs at 9.03/14.65 and 53.99/59.61 um; y = 321.30 (row 85) leaves carved stripe segments above and below so VDD! and VDDARRAY! are fed without crossing the Metal4 OBS bar between them. Orientation FS (user decision 2026-10-17): signal pins (Metal2) on the top edge, facing the TT IO pins (y = 710) and the logic; with N, A_DOUT exceeded its 0.064 pF max cap and A_DIN[9-11] max slew. Under FS, VDDARRAY! is fed from the stripe segments below and VDD! from those above.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
